$comment: Golden vectors for the Step 3 planetary formulas.
Every case is taken from a statement in the original game manual
(documentation/MANUAL.PDF) rather than from our implementation, so that a
regression here means the code drifted from the documented rule and not
merely from itself. The Ghidra routine each case exercises is named so the
vector can be re-derived from the binary.
Population and maximum population are in the game's stored unit of 100

cases.why: an optimal planet supports 1,000,000
all races but two top out at 1,000,000 on an optimal world
a 50% planet supports only 500,000
Hyper-Expansion is limited to half the typical maximum
Jack-of-All-Trades gets 20% more: 1,200,000
Jack-of-All-Trades with Only Basic Remote Mining: 1,320,000
planets below 5% are all treated as 5%
a -9% planet kills 0.9% of its colonists a year
a -1% planet kills 0.1% a year
deaths from overcrowding reach 12% a year at 400% of capacity
1,000,000 colonists at 1 resource per 1000 colonists, no factories
1000 factories producing 10 resources per 10 factories
population between 100% and 300% of capacity works at 50% efficiency
population past 300% of capacity does no useful work at all
100 mines at concentration 50, 10 mines producing 10 kT: 50 kT a year
10 mines at concentration 100 produce 10 kT
two mines per extra kT of germanium at concentration 50

concentration_decay.why: mine-years to reduce a concentration by one is 12500 / concentration

cases.why: two 100 ly scanners and one 60 ly scanner combine to 120 ly
a single scanner is its own range
no scanners is no range
a fleet covers warp^2 light years a year
warp 1 covers 1 light year
warp 10 covers 100 light years
